question: Elon Musk # tweets August 7 - August 14, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from August 7 12:00 PM ET to August 14, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure is the "Post Counter" on xtracker.polymarket.com for the "Elon Musk # tweets August 7 - August 14, 2026?" tracking. Its window runs from 2026-08-07 16:00 UTC to 2026-08-14 15:59:59 UTC. [xtracker API](https://xtracker.polymarket.com/api/users/elonmusk/trackings)
- 2026-08-09: the main tracker page showed only "Loading users...", so I pulled the numbers from the tracker's own API. [xtracker](https://xtracker.polymarket.com)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the outcome yet. About 45 of the 168 hours have passed, with about 52 posts so far.
- That works out to about 27.7 posts a day. Held for the full week, that would give about 194, inside the 180-199 bucket. The remaining time (about 5.1 days) is long compared with how much his posting swings, so the count is far from locked in.
- Posting comes in bursts: 11 posts in the 15:00 hour on 2026-08-08, and many hours with zero.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- I found no specific news from August 8-9, 2026 likely to change his posting volume.

What these show:
- **Range:** 123 to 281 across those 8 weeks (six non-overlapping, plus two overlapping). The median is about 209 and the mean about 212.
- **Trend:** the last three weeks fell from 270 to 223 to 187.
- **Day-to-day swings:** full days ranged from 12 to 58 posts. That makes a ±40 to 60 swing over the remaining 5 days quite plausible.
- I did not check counts from before June 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (by 2026-08-14 16:00 UTC)
- I found no scheduled Musk events for August 9-14 (product launches, earnings, launches or political events).
- The main risk is an unscheduled news cycle, such as politics, xAI/Grok or SpaceX/Tesla news. In past weeks these pushed single days to 40-58 posts, which could quickly move the total up a bucket or two. Quiet days of about 12-20 posts would push it toward 160-179.
- Weekends: from 2026-08-08 to 08-09 he has been posting at about the same rate as on recent weekdays. The rest of the window (August 10-14) falls on weekdays.
